videos.caption: FAA Says Airport Only Had One Controller At Time Of Collision #usa #america  The FAA says the helicopter and plane collided because there weren’t enough Air Traffic Controllers. Reagan National was operating with one controller who had to manage all air traffic in the area & that tower typically has at least two controllers for the level of traffic the area was under at the time. So the controller who was handling helicopters was also handling landings and departures of planes. This comes after Trump froze the hiring of Air Traffic Controllers and offered them buy outs to leave their jobs earlier this week. He also reportedly fired hundreds of critical staff & allowed Elon to seemingly push the head of the FAA out. Just this past summer, the FAA released a report that it needed 3,000 more air traffic controllers nationally. This morning Trump blamed DEI DEI DEI. But Trump is doubling down on this lie with him now signing a Presidential memorandum ordering competence over DEI. When asked if he planned to visit the crash site which is down the street from him, he said “What's the site, the water? You want me to go swimming?"
